title: Segmented token-lag profiles and fastpath alert squelch
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: We observed a recurring class of production incidents where a small fraction of invocations exhibit multi-segment token lag (latency concentrated in the middle segments of generation rather than coldstart or finalization). These long-tail segments cause cost spikes and noisy alerts because existing SLOs and alert rules attribute cost/latency to whole-invocation percentiles.

Goal: Provide finer-grained observability and alert control by: 1) emitting segmented token-lag histograms (pre-token, prefix, mid-segment, tail) and per-segment cost counters, 2) adding a fastpath detection flag to traces so low-cost single-chunk invocations can be squelched from noise-sensitive alerts, and 3) creating dashboard panels and an alert-squelch policy for noisy mid-segment blips.

What this PR includes: checklist - [x] runtime metric hooks for segment buckets and per-segment cost meters, [x] tracer enrichment with "fastpath" boolean and segment offsets, [x] aggregation rollup job for segmented histograms (hourly rollups + 7d downsample), [x] new Grafana dashboard panels (Segmented token-lag heatmap, fastpath ratio timeseries, per-tenant segment cost share), [x] alert rule change: add squelch rule to mute SLO-noise for invocations marked fastpath and for tenants with >95% fastpath within last 5m, [x] unit + integration tests, [x] short operational playbook fragment.

Backward compatibility and safety: Metrics use new stable names with tag-based versioning (telemetry.v=2). Tracing enrichment is additive and guarded behind a feature flag (obs.segmented_token_lag_enabled) rolled out by default for internal staging and opt-in for private deployments. Alert squelch is declarative and non-blocking; we keep original alerts and add an aggregated suppression layer that is reversible.

Notes/links: internal runbook reference: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2190/segment-lag-investigation; benchmark notes live in repo subdir observability/testdata/segment-bench.

Impact: initial rollout shows a ~28% reduction in alert noise on the nightly canary tenant and isolates the long-tail cost to a small tenant cohort for further tuning.

Testing: Local unit tests for histogram bucketing, end-to-end integration against the observability staging cluster with synthetic traces (script included). CI verifies telemetry schema and linting.

Requested merge strategy: squash and merge to keep metric commit tidy.
commits_summary: 4 commits: 1) add runtime metric hooks and feature flag wiring; 2) tracer: add fastpath flag + segment offsets; 3) aggregation job + rollup tests; 4) dashboards, alerts, and playbook fragment
review_conversation: Rohan Iyer: Nice approach to bucket by segment offsets — two comments: can we make the mid-segment bucket boundary configurable and add a short note on how it maps to common generation lengths?
Maya Chen: Good point, added config via obs.segmented_bucket_boundaries and documented typical mappings in sdk/telemetry/schema_v2.md.
Lena Kovalenko: The fastpath flag looks fine but we should be careful about privacy for private deployments. Can we gate tracer enrichment behind KMS-enabled telemetry?
Maya Chen: Tracing enrichment is gated by the feature flag and we added an extra check so private installs with telemetry.upload=false will not emit fastpath. Added tests to confirm.
Diego Martinez: CI failure on lint in first run — minor formatting. Verified in second CI run after fix. Approved pending squash.
Rohan Iyer: Approved. Also pinged infra to watch rollup job memory usage during the first week.
Maya Chen: Addressed infra note, reduced in-memory aggregation window; added a 5% memory cap and metrics to alert if exceeded.
merge_outcome: squash and merge by Maya Chen — merge commit created and pushed to main. No post-merge rollbacks. Observability feature flag enabled for staging; gradual rollout scheduled.
release_notes: Introduce segmented token-lag telemetry and fastpath alert squelch. Adds new Grafana panels and a non-destructive alert suppression rule to reduce noise from short, single-chunk invocations. Backward-compatible metric names (telemetry.v=2).
operational_playbook_snippet: 1) If mid-segment cost spikes increase warnings: check segmented_token_lag_histogram and segment-rollup-mem-usage; 2) To disable fastpath squelch for a tenant: set tenant.alert_squelch.fastpath=false in monitoring config; 3) Rollback: revert feature flag obs.segmented_token_lag_enabled or disable rollup job via orchestration UI.
notes_for_release_manager: Enable telemetry.v=2 in staging first week, monitor segment-rollup-mem-usage alert (created in this PR). Coordinate with infra for rollup job scaling on Wed maintenance window.
